samples.name: bugfix.yaml（bugfix）
samples.yaml:
# bug-fix sample (P0.5 execution; P0 only checks that it can be written).
# design(plan) -> build(修复自测) -> verify(测试验证) -> ops(运维合入)
# verify --fail(<=2 iterations)--> build   (bounded retry edge back to an ancestor)
# verify --pass--> ops                       (leaves the loop)
# The "test(复现)" step is not part of this sample: `test` only emits report(file)
# and cannot feed build.plan(tree) (#流水线:#10, 员工一号 991cb4d7). The plain
# build -> verify edge stays as the way into the loop.
id: bugfix
version: 1
entry: design
nodes:
  - id: design
    uses: block:design@1
    with:
      request: "{{input.request}}"
  - id: build
    uses: block:build@1
  - id: verify
    uses: block:verify@1
  - id: ops
    uses: block:ops@1
edges:
  - from: design
    to: build
  - from: build
    to: verify
  - id: verify-to-build
    from: verify
    to: build
    on:
      from: check.result
      status: fail
    max_iterations: 2
    on_exhausted: human_gate:ops-lead
  - id: verify-to-ops
    from: verify
    to: ops
    on:
      from: check.result
      status: pass

samples.name: main.yaml（main）
samples.yaml:
# Linear P0 sample: design -> build -> verify
id: main
version: 1
entry: design
nodes:

    uses: block:design@1

  - id: build

edges:

    to: build
  - from: build
    to: verify

note: 这两份是仓库 flows/ 的原文，由 tools/canvas-sync.mjs 生成（test/canvas.test.js 校验它们与仓库文件一致）。
